evals.prompt: Build a member registration form with 14 fields.
evals.expected_output: Fields chunked into titled sections or steps with visible progress, one dominant 44px primary CTA, flexible input formats, a designed success state, and a self-audit in the audit-template format.
expectations: Splits the 14 fields into labelled sections (fieldset/legend) or steps, citing Miller or Chunking
If stepped, shows done vs left (e.g. 'Step 2 of 3') and saves partial progress (Zeigarnik / Goal-Gradient)
Exactly one filled primary button, at least 44px tall, labelled verb + object (Fitts / Von Restorff)
No Reset button adjacent to the primary action
Phone / IC inputs accept spaces and dashes and normalise them (Postel)
Spacing encodes grouping: label-to-field gap smaller than field-to-field gap (Proximity)
Includes a success state with a reference and next step (Peak-End)
Ends with a self-audit using the 6-pillar table, guardrails line and top 3 fixes

evals.prompt: Design a pricing page with 3 tiers and monthly/annual billing.
evals.expected_output: Counts the choice combinations, marks one honest recommended tier, aligned comparison rows, a single billing toggle, total price visible with no hidden costs, one primary CTA per tier card inside its card.
expectations: States the number of options/combinations the user must evaluate (e.g. 3 tiers x 2 billing = 6) (Hick)
Marks one recommended tier, and only with a truthful reason (Hick / Cognitive Bias)
Features are listed in the same rows in the same order across tiers for comparison (Choice Overload)
Each tier's button sits inside its own card (Common Region)
Annual savings are real and computed; no fake 'was' prices or countdowns (Ethics)
Total price including tax/fees is clear; no pre-selected paid add-ons (Ethics)
Only the recommended tier's button is the filled, dominant style (Von Restorff)

evals.expected_output: Uses audit-template.md exactly: verdict, score x/6, one row per finding with Pass/Fail/N/A, exact element with file:line, law tags, concrete fix and severity; guardrails line; top 3 fixes; not-verified list.
expectations: Output starts with '## UX Audit — <screen>' and a Verdict and Score x/6 line
Every Fail row names a specific element with a file:line or selector
Every Fail row has a concrete fix (classes, sizes, copy or position), not advice like 'improve hierarchy'
Each row cites at least one law tag
Guardrails (A11y, Ethics, States) are reported separately
Items that cannot be checked statically are listed as not verified, not passed
Lists the top 3 fixes in order of impact
